name: proschi
description: Agent skills for Proschi, architecture diagrams as text with a simulation: model existing systems, write request flows from code, plan capacity, review designs and keep diagrams in sync.

plugins.name: proschi
plugins.description: Skills that turn infrastructure, code and docs into checked Proschi architecture models (infra-to-proschi, image-to-proschi, code-to-usecases, proschi-capacity-plan, proschi-design-review, proschi-keep-in-sync, proschi-hld-doc), and diagrams drawn in Claude Code's terminal with a player for their use cases.
